Name: Auto Break Geode
Author: weizinai
Description:
[font=Arial][size=6][b]Introduce
[/b][/size][/font][size=3]
The mod can help you automatically break geodes and speed up geode break animation.When you are on the geode menu, hold  geodes and press the shortcut key ([/size][color=#ff0000][b]default is F[/b][/color][size=3]), the mod will start working. It applies to geodes, golden coconuts, and mysterious boxes added in 1.6 that can be cracked by the blacksmith.[/size]
